summary: Technical Partner at Lightspeed Faction (Faction, JV with Lightspeed). I designed and built the Faction AI Agent: an agent harness (multi-model agentic loop, pluggable hook pipeline, MCP tool orchestration across 170+ tools, three-layer RAG memory, declarative skills, multi-platform delivery) and the firm's VC deal flow agent built on it. The investment team uses it daily to triage decks, run research briefings, mine X/Twitter for signals, and monitor portfolio companies. Beyond the agent, I run the firm's technical due diligence (214 deals reviewed, 70+ deep tech DDs so far), author category research across 9 verticals (AI × crypto, agents, ZK, rollups & MEV, PETs, quantum, Solana, data platforms, agentic commerce), and advise portfolio CTOs on architecture. 30+ years of production engineering before this. Co-founder of Collab.Land (3M users), creator of LoopBack (OpenJS Foundation, 1.9M downloads in the past 12 months and 14M+ lifetime), former IBM STSM on API Connect, Apache Tuscany committer.
